title: Voynich Manuscript Research
subtitle: The investigation at a glance: evidence, transcription, findings and next tests

pages.alt: Five stages from source records to translation. Inventories and exploratory constraints exist; a leading-y rule has a diagnostic. A valid unseen evaluation, supported translation and independent reproduction remain pending.

pages.alt: Ten pilot sides across six groups; 213 Yale scan views and 204 numbered side labels count distinct units. Seven pilot page links need image/glyph review; 67r, 68r and 85v retain mapping gaps. Shared scans remain dependent evidence.
pages.caption: What the evidence covers
pages.credit: Generated with built-in image_gen from accepted public project reports at main 1c74085. Layout and diagrams are explanatory, not manuscript evidence.
pages.note: Counts describe distinct units, not verified image coverage. Provisional panel/region records do not pass the pilot readiness gate; shared scans and overlapping inventories remain dependent evidence.

pages.alt: ZL3b and IT2a are related representations. Spacing and ambiguity policies matter. Of 2,940 eligible P0 loci, 2,054 share a chain; 562 split and 767 join loci have boundary disagreements. The counts overlap.
pages.caption: How transcription choices affect the evidence
pages.credit: Generated with built-in image_gen from accepted public project reports at main 1c74085. Layout and diagrams are explanatory, not manuscript evidence.
pages.note: The boundary disagreement counts overlap at 359 loci and must not be added. These related editions do not establish physical glyphs, words or correct readings.

pages.alt: Exploratory findings with limits: 272 repeated pairs versus 270.77 expected; interior order above half-controls with positional alternatives; previous-length prediction loses every fold; matched y selectivity drops from +0.3923 to +0.1064.
pages.caption: What the tests show
pages.credit: Generated with built-in image_gen from accepted public project reports at main 1c74085. Layout and diagrams are explanatory, not manuscript evidence.
pages.note: Studies use different cohorts and statistics on previously exposed data. IT split/join interior treatments are identical dependent comparisons. String lookup and conditional-control departures establish no glyph function, language or translation.

pages.alt: Next: review glyphs and mappings; declare exposure and dependencies; freeze rules and failure conditions; test without retuning; reproduce and translate supported passages. Issue 13 is open, and the proposed 8/2 split remains unestablished.
